QuestInfo.name: 5th Job: Preparing for Power
QuestInfo.0: After reaching Lv. 200, you receive a message from the Temple of Time. Go see #b#p2140000##k.
QuestInfo.1: To prove to #b#p2140000##k that you can handle these new dimensional powers, return once you have a #btotal of 100 Star Force or more#k and one #bweapon at 10 Stars or more#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have the power now, as #b#p2140000##k advised. Now all you need is the guidance of #b#p2140001##k...
QuestInfo.demandSummary:
Reach total of 100 Star Force
Reach 10 Stars on weapon

0.0: Now it's time for you to travel to a dimension where a greater power is needed.
0.1: You will need your #bnew power#k to survive there. Prove you can handle the powers of another world if you don't want to submit to it.
0.2: If you want to go deeper, you'll need to pass a more difficult test. Will you answer the call?
0.3: If you have the power, #b#p2140001##k will seek you out.\r\n#r#e(Talk to the Temple Keeper again after gaining at least 100 total Star Force and a 10-Star weapon.)#k#n

no.0: You aren't ready yet. Talk to them again when you're ready.

1.0: You feel a strong power within. It should be enough to pull through.

yes.0: #b#p2140001##k will guide you to the trial.

default.0: They'll be waiting for you.\r\n\r\n#r#e(Talk to the Temple Keeper again after gaining at least 100 total Star Force and a 10-Star weapon.)#k#n
